summary_for_vector_search: An ambitious early-career developer with a solid foundation in core frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and exposure to modern libraries like React or Vue. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong aptitude for learning, actively contributes to codebases via Git, and showcases technical competence through a personal portfolio or GitHub activity. They should be prepared to thrive in a collaborative, agile environment where mentorship and rapid skill acquisition are key components of the role.
must_haves: Basic experience with a modern framework (React.js, Vue.js, or Angular)
Understanding of Responsive Web Design principles
nice_to_haves: Basic Backend knowledge (Node.js, Python, or PHP)
Familiarity with CSS Preprocessors (SASS/LESS) or Tailwind
Exposure to UI/UX design tools (Figma, Adobe XD)
deal_breakers: Inability to explain basic DOM manipulation
Lack of foundational HTML/CSS knowledge (relying solely on drag-and-drop tools)
cultural_vibe: Growth-oriented and mentorship-focused environment that values curiosity, proactive problem-solving, and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies.
